title: Updating scores by index
description: You can follow a loop that reads and replaces each list element.

steps.description: scores contains three values. You loop over indices 0, 1 and 2 using range(len(scores)).
Each iteration prints its index and current score. This print comes before the update.

steps.question: What value replaces the first score, 88?
steps.answer: 93 replaces it because the assignment adds five to scores[0].

steps.description: You update all three elements and print [93, 100, 78]. The earlier score messages show the original values because they ran before each assignment.
